en: On a phone, swipe right to open the menu, and left to close it
The page stays on screen while it is read again
Leaving the Costume or Nickname and title page drops its unsaved edits
Every costume in History keeps its picture
zh-Hans: 手机上往右划打开菜单，往左划关上
下拉重新读取时，页面留在原地
离开换装页或昵称与称号页时，未保存的修改会清掉
历史记录里的每套装束都有图片
